mentions.name: PeakAgent
mentions.description: An AI-powered page optimizer for SaaS and ecommerce sites. Installs via a single script on the existing stack, auto-generates variants for heroes, copy, CTAs, and social proof, continuously tests them and routes traffic to the best-performing variants, and reports on conversion and revenue lift rather than clicks. Optimized for key pages like pricing, signup, product, and checkout, with plans for deeper ad→page→revenue attribution and segment-based personalization.
mentions.problem: Avoids the complex setup of typical optimization tools by letting sites drop in a script and keep their existing stack
mentions.audience: SaaS and ecommerce site owners looking to improve conversion on key pages
mentions.source_excerpt:
